**The available evidence cannot establish whether the clearing was illegal.** It identifies 13.5 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2025, of which 13.1 hectares overlapped native forest on Uruguay’s 2021 national forest map. The loss has not yet been corroborated by a later year of observations.

A legal determination also requires checking whether the clearing was authorized and whether any applicable exceptions or permits applied. Confirm the event on the ground and consult MGAP’s forestry authority and relevant permit records.
